sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Rail conversion factors were updated in 2026 using new ORR and Transport for London data.
International rail (Eurostar) uses passenger-km-normalised CO2e data from the ORR portal.
Eurostar calculations use electricity consumed on the UK side only.
Eurostar CO2e is calculated using UK grid-electricity conversion factors.
National Rail represents average emissions per passenger kilometre for diesel and electric trains in 2024-25.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve mode mix and data year.

facts.source_fact: National Rail uses electricity and diesel consumed by passenger operators plus passenger-km from LENNON.
Rail CH4 and N2O factors were not refreshed in 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not imply 2026 non-CO2 data refresh.

facts.source_fact: Rail CH4 and N2O factors were aligned to AR5 GWP values in 2025.
Light-rail factors combine multiple UK tram and light-rail systems and use updated passenger-km and grid-electricity inputs.
The average light-rail factor is weighted by relative passenger kilometres across the included systems.
